reviewer: Lead AI — preliminary wording only, not independent human approval

SELLER_HYPOTHESIS.reason: The inspected wording requests selling/listing help. A seller-intent hypothesis only; verify actual service, property, authority, mandate, permission and factual scope before admission.

LANDLORD_HYPOTHESIS.reason: The inspected wording requests letting/tenant-finding or landlord help. Keep separate from tenant demand and property-management provision; verify genuine service and authority before admission.

BUYER_RESEARCH_OTHER_ROLE.reason: Premises for-sale wording is a buyer-research hypothesis, not proof that the searcher owns a property. Preserve asset, locality, readiness, budget and price constraints; no actual inventory, price or family binding is asserted.

MANAGEMENT_PRODUCER_HOLD.reason: Management, asset/building management, contracts or manage-my-property wording needs an actual authorized producer and supported scope. It does not establish a simple letting service or an operational capability; retain community/name ambiguity.

SHORT_STAY_PRODUCER_HOLD.reason: Holiday/short-term/Airbnb management needs an actual licensed service/provider, mandate and supported business case. Do not silently admit it as ordinary long-term letting or exclude it automatically.

SOFTWARE_OR_TOOL_HOLD.reason: The phrase asks for real-estate/property-management software or tools. No product/provider is confirmed; retain for scope review rather than turning it into a property enquiry or automatic negative.

VALUATION_EVIDENCE_HOLD.reason: Value/valuation/estimate wording needs verified service, method, purpose, qualified reviewer and any applicable authorization. No professional valuation, calculator, price or asset is invented.

PROVIDER_OR_PORTAL_CONTEXT_HOLD.reason: The literal contains a named provider, developer-service or portal context. Navigation, comparison and brokerage fit remain unresolved; no brand-wide exclusion, affiliation or right to use a name follows.

AGENCY_OR_LIST_SCOPE_HOLD.reason: Generic realtor/agency or property/developer-list wording leaves role, list purpose or actual inventory unclear. No seller ownership, purchased list, named service or inventory is inferred.

SELLER_BUYER_AMBIGUITY_HOLD.reason: For-sell/to-sell wording can describe available premises or an owner request. Keep the full phrase unresolved instead of forcing buyer or seller intent from the token sell.

TENURE_OR_DISTRESS_HOLD.reason: Freehold or distress-sale constraints need dated subject, legal/commercial and inventory evidence. Preserve purchase demand without claiming tenure, urgency or eligibility.

MAINTENANCE_PRODUCER_HOLD.reason: Property maintenance is a separate operational service requiring a real provider and approved scope. Do not turn it into landlord letting, a confirmed capability or an automatic negative.

DISPUTE_SERVICE_HOLD.reason: A rental dispute is not an ordinary immediate rental or letting requirement. Qualified service/legal scope is unresolved; no legal advice, provider or automatic exclusion is created.
